rounds.text: Investors face severe structural risks regarding shareholder returns, highlighted by a dividend yield of 0.00% despite the company reporting repeated profits [E4, E62]. Compounding this capital allocation concern, the data provider explicitly flags that the company might be capitalizing its interest cost [E63], casting doubt on the true quality of reported earnings. The historical volatility of the stock is exceptionally high at 78.1% [E54], and past performance reveals a catastrophic worst peak-to-trough drawdown of -95.7% [E53]. Furthermore, operating margins exhibit an inconsistent trend over the last year and the last two quarters [E32, E33], pointing to operational instability. Conceded: the company has delivered strong profit growth and a solid 3-year median ROE of 31.8% [E60].
